clips.title: The story
paras: Jerod's Landing is a modest river dock situated on the Elwynn Forest bank of the Nazferiti River. Currently seized by the Defias Brotherhood, the outpost serves as a clandestine transfer point for illicit shipments smuggled across the kingdom's waterways.

Tucked away along the eastern waters of the Nazferiti River, Jerod's Landing provides river access connecting Elwynn Forest to neighboring territories. While originally an ordinary boat dock, the site has fallen firmly into the hands of the Defias Brotherhood. Under the watchful eye of a Defias dockmaster, outlaws utilize the dock as a hub to receive goods plundered from the Redridge Mountains, discreetly moving river cargo downstream toward holdings such as Klaven's Tower in Westfall.
